scope: Technical reference catalog for this conversation and isolated concept-production pipeline
authority_boundary: Epic documents explain tools. Game Requirements, RequirementsState, canon and delegated concept decisions retain project authority. No model, rig, plugin enablement, import, performance or owner acceptance established.
verification_boundary: Sources verified through primary-source search extracts and page-version labels, not an exhaustive line-by-line manual audit. Three requested version-pinned opens were unavailable; retain observed 5.7 labels and require 5.8.2 compatibility checks.
native_chat_sources: No callable tool found to mutate a native chat Sources list. Catalog is saved in the workspace, linked in this conversation, and opened as a file in this task.

research_routing.parent: catalog integration and modeling/material/VFX/platform research; sole file writer
research_routing.specialist: evidence_researcher; read-only animation source research; configured gpt-5.6-terra medium role

sources.title: Recommended Asset Naming Conventions
sources.echoes_application: Use type prefixes with reserved EBS IDs; Epic examples do not rename our stable concept IDs.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Coordinate System and Spaces
sources.echoes_application: Check handedness, axes and export transforms against the planned +X forward, +Y right, +Z up contract.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Units of Measurement
sources.echoes_application: Bind centimeters and import scale to the authoritative gameplay footprint, not artwork labels.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Unreal Engine 5.8 Release Notes
sources.echoes_application: Recheck import, rendering and animation changes before choosing tools for the installed 5.8.2 build.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Modeling Mode Overview
sources.echoes_application: Blockout, topology, material assignments and baking. The page marks Modeling Mode Beta; validate the chosen workflow.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: UV Editor
sources.echoes_application: Unwrap and inspect UV layout for ceramic panels, mineral surfaces and Choir panes before texturing.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: FBX Static Mesh Pipeline
sources.echoes_application: Export pivots, triangulation, UVs, collision and LODs. Epic specifies FBX 2020.2; retain exporter settings and test the actual importer.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Importing Assets Using Interchange
sources.echoes_application: Capture the selected import pipeline and reimport options. Do not assume the runtime Blueprint example supports skeletal meshes or animations.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Static Mesh Editor UI
sources.echoes_application: Inspect bounds, UVs, materials, collision and LOD previews; verify UI differences in 5.8.2.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Geometry Scripting User Guide
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate reproducible mesh construction utilities for panel counts and roots; preserve source-first generation and do not execute import/mutation examples during audit.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Setting Up Collisions With Static Meshes
sources.echoes_application: Separate simple gameplay collision from cosmetic geometry; verify footprints and selection traces at integration.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Using Sockets With Static Meshes
sources.echoes_application: Author building attachment transforms for production exits, power connections, effects and moving subassemblies.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Navigation Components
sources.echoes_application: Inspect possible nav effects of imported components; Unreal navigation is not a replacement for EchoesSimCore movement authority.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Physically Based Materials
sources.echoes_application: Define base color, metallic and roughness intent for Meridian ceramic/metal, Kharuun mineral-organic surfaces and Choir forms.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Creating and Using Material Instances
sources.echoes_application: Expose faction, team, damage and state parameters while retaining shared material parents and bounded permutations.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Texture Asset Editor
sources.echoes_application: Verify channels, color-space choices, compression, mip behavior and texture dimensions in the actual target platform.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Texture Streaming Overview
sources.echoes_application: Plan mip residency across RTS camera distances and dense armies; a high-resolution source is not a runtime budget.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Texture Streaming Metrics
sources.echoes_application: Retain streaming pool and wanted-mip measurements from representative gameplay scenes.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Using Transparency in Materials
sources.echoes_application: Review overlapping Bulwark panes and Choir effects for overdraw and state visibility; do not assume translucency is required.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Decal Materials
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate selection, footprint, damage and spent-Well surface marks; confirm receiving material, fade and platform behavior.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Creating Visual Effects in Niagara
sources.echoes_application: Entry point for construction, weapons, sensing, Well telegraphs and state effects driven by authorized simulation events.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Niagara Overview
sources.echoes_application: Understand systems, emitters, modules and parameters; confirm version-specific controls in 5.8.2.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Scalability and Best Practices for Niagara
sources.echoes_application: Use effect types, culling and instance budgets for many simultaneous RTS effects; important state communication must survive lower quality tiers.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Measuring Performance in Niagara
sources.echoes_application: Measure simulation and rendering overhead plus overlapping-particle overdraw in crowded combat.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Destruction Overview
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate cosmetic fragments/caches only where justified. Clear gameplay occupancy immediately; Future Wells are indestructible and Harvest is a protocol transition.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Audio Engine Overview
sources.echoes_application: Map mechanical, mineral and Choir sound intent to the existing audio pipeline; visual timing alone does not establish audio acceptance.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Sound Attenuation
sources.echoes_application: Check listener placement and distance behavior at RTS camera heights for sockets and state loops.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: MetaSounds Quick Start
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate parameter-driven machinery and resonance loops without replacing existing audio authority. The retrieved page carries a Beta notice.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Static Mesh Automatic LOD Generation
sources.echoes_application: Build reductions against per-asset triangle caps, preserving silhouettes, panes, emitters and functional detail.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Nanite Technical Details
sources.echoes_application: Capability reference only: current production contracts keep Nanite OFF; adoption requires a separate measured platform decision.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: macOS Development Requirements
sources.echoes_application: Check platform feature constraints before rendering choices. Epic lists Nanite/VSM M2+ beta and no hardware-ray-traced Lumen support on this page.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Instanced Static Mesh Component
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate repeated props and environment modules; grouping must preserve required selection, state and visibility behavior.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Viewport Modes
sources.echoes_application: Inspect wireframe, lighting and shader complexity at representative cameras; shader instruction visualization is not measured frame time.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Introduction to Performance Profiling and Configuration
sources.echoes_application: Identify CPU/GPU/memory bottlenecks before optimization; do not transfer Windows graphics-debugger examples to Mac without checking support.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Unreal Insights
sources.echoes_application: Retain trace evidence with build/device/camera/crowd identity for later Technical Gate acceptance.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Landscape Technical Guide
sources.echoes_application: Reference for campaign terrain dimensions, components and collision; no authorization to reshape current maps.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Importing and Exporting Landscape Heightmaps
sources.echoes_application: Preserve heightmap source, precision and world scale for later environment packages.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Scripting the Unreal Editor Using Python
sources.echoes_application: Reference for later editor automation. The page marks the feature Experimental; isolate read-only audits from mutating asset scripts.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Data Validation
sources.echoes_application: Define asset naming, metadata and budget validators; built-in command-line validation runs C++ rules by default, so register other rule types explicitly.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Reference Viewer
sources.echoes_application: Inspect asset dependency graphs at integration; engine dependencies supplement rather than replace concept provenance.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: FBX Skeletal Mesh Pipeline
sources.echoes_application: Bind skin, animation, morph, UV and LOD exports; verify FBX 2020.2 and actual import settings.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Importing Skeletal Meshes Using FBX
sources.echoes_application: Follow the import and mesh-inspection workflow; only reuse a Skeleton after compatibility review.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Skeletons
sources.echoes_application: Preserve anatomy-specific hierarchies; do not force bipeds, quadrupeds and moving structures onto one skeleton.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Skeletal Mesh Sockets
sources.echoes_application: Map planned attachments to bones or mesh sockets and verify required sockets survive bone LOD reduction.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Rigging with Control Rig
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate authoring controls for legs, recoil braces, roots and pane chains; no rig exists merely because a contract lists controls.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: IK Rig Editor
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate terrain contact and appendage placement per anatomy without altering authoritative movement.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: IK Rig Animation Retargeting
sources.echoes_application: Reuse compatible motion only after chain/pose mapping and contact/sliding review; preserve source animation rights.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Animation Sequences
sources.echoes_application: Produce and verify each planned motion track, including start/hold/cancel/recovery and load restoration where applicable.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Animation Blueprints
sources.echoes_application: Consume deterministic simulation state for pose presentation; never create competing gameplay authority.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Blend Spaces in Animation Blueprints
sources.echoes_application: Blend locomotion/turn poses from authorized movement where useful; not every asset needs a blend space.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: State Machines
sources.echoes_application: Map visible construction, damage and operational transitions; authoritative simulation events still determine state.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Animation Notifies
sources.echoes_application: Synchronize cosmetic audio/VFX, never resource awards, damage resolution, Well protocols or authoritative orders.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Root Motion
sources.echoes_application: Keep authoritative RTS translation simulation-owned; assess root motion only for approved isolated visual/cinematic uses and thread cost.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Physics Asset Editor
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate bodies/constraints for cosmetic response; separate them from gameplay collision and navigation.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Skeletal Mesh LODs
sources.echoes_application: Reduce geometry and bones within contract budgets while preserving feet, silhouettes and required socket transforms.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Animation Optimization
sources.echoes_application: Profile crowded RTS animation cost and game-thread work before choosing optimizations.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Animation Budget Allocator
sources.echoes_application: Evaluate quality/tick throttling only after plugin and platform checks; essential state visibility must remain reliable.
sources.verification: Epic documentation title and relevant extracted search content reviewed

sources.title: Skeletal Mesh Editor
sources.echoes_application: Inspect imported mesh, skeleton, skinning, materials, bounds and LOD presentation before integration.
